oneOf.description: combine two components of the bag into the finished item (recipes in items.json); answered with `result`, then a `bag_event` and the new `state`

oneOf.description: Revision 7, queue server only: look for a match. bots = you + AI players at once; normal = wait for other players (AI players fill the empty seats after the server's fill time).
